name: Electro
description: The Minks' electricity, from a spark to a field of lightning.

stages.name: A spark
stages.description: Let a spark jump from your fur.
stages.text: A spark jumped from your fur to the iron door.

stages.name: Charged strikes
stages.description: Strike with lightning held in the fist.
stages.text: Your strike crackled as it landed.

stages.name: A discharge field
stages.description: Let it all go at once.
stages.text: Lightning burst out of you in every direction.
